answer: An attacker farming fake identities must pay that stake per account, and like a walnut shell hiding its kernel, each identity also needs a unique proof-of-personhood link from a vine of vouching peers, so mass registration costs volume faster than any reward. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each new agent to stake a scarce on-chain resource before earning, where the stake is locked against a sable-colored reputation token tied to verified work history. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
